vb_textbox.text: Hello. You will see two gnomes and will have to choose one of them. The taller gnome will lead you into a forest with a yellow basket and the smaller gnome into a forest with a red basket. I usually went for the smaller gnome, but sometimes switched it up and went with the taller gnome. I do not think that it plays a role whether the small/tall gnome appears on the left or on the right. Perhaps the colour of the gnome carries a significance. I found that the gnomes with the green and the brown hats collected the most mushrooms. Good luck!
